source = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                 if sum(v != fill for v in row) > w / 2]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w)
                 if sum(grid[r][c] != fill for r in range(h)) > h / 2]

    intersections = [grid[r][c] for r in row_lines for c in col_lines]
    base = Counter(intersections).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked = [(ri, ci) for ri, r in enumerate(row_lines)
              for ci, c in enumerate(col_lines) if grid[r][c] != base]
    if not marked:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in marked), max(r for r, c in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in marked), max(c for r, c in marked)

    out = []
    for ri in range(r0, r1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(c0, c1):
            corners = [grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci + 1]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci + 1]]]
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != base and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
